C0189.title: CCTV 3·15 Gala Exposes Cloud-Controlled Livestream Popularity Inflation
C0189.summary: The 2023 CCTV 3·15 Gala exposed entities including Jiaxing Yuhe Culture Media and Shaanxi Yarunjin Network Technology that provided cloud-control systems able to let one phone manipulate large numbers of water-army accounts, bulk-like livestreams, inflate popularity, and induce consumers to follow others into placing orders.

references.title: CCTV 3·15 Gala: The puppets behind hot livestream rooms, water-army operators induce follow-on orders, one phone controls 20,000 accounts
